NAME
  sprint four-dx reports — Browse subcommands.

SYNOPSIS

DESCRIPTION
  Choose a subcommand, then inspect its exact --help before execution.

SUBCOMMANDS
  correct             Append replacement with supersedes=ID; preserve original history
  create              create authorized 4DX reports; server validates permissions and revisions
  get                 get authorized 4DX reports; server validates permissions and revisions
  list                list authorized 4DX reports; server validates permissions and revisions
  void                Void history entry with JSON reason; preserve original history

EXAMPLES
  sprint four-dx reports get --help

GLOBAL FLAGS

  --profile NAME             Select a private Sprint profile (default: default).
  --token-file FILE          Use an owned mode 0600 automation-token JSON file.
  --non-interactive          Never prompt; startup auto-update is skipped.
  --wait                     Observe an accepted job without retrying the mutation.
  --timeout SECONDS          Wait timeout, 1..3600; requires --wait (default: 30).
